title: Specification-first convergence with an AI coding agent: a case study of dismantling a core architectural invariant across 189 files in a 717k-line codebase with no test oracle and no human code review
abstract: arXiv:2608.12440v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper reports a single, fully instrumented case study of a large-scale architectural refactoring by an AI coding agent under a specification-first protocol, with no human review of the generated code and no pre-existing oracle to validate the target behaviour. The task, dismantling a central invariant across a large interdependent codebase, was assessed by the author as effectively infeasible through incremental refactoring, the kind of change that conventionally calls for a rewrite instead. Under the protocol described here, the agent completed it successfully.   The system is a 717,725-line production TypeScript application across 3,648 files. The task required dismantling a core lifetime invariant: the guarantee that a UI panel remains open for the duration of an AI request. translated_title: 以规范优先与AI编码代理实现收敛：一项在无测试预言机且无人工代码审查的717k行代码库中拆除核心架构不变量的案例研究
translated_abstract: 本文报告了一项单一、完全仪器化的案例研究，该研究涉及AI编码代理在规范优先协议下进行的大规模架构重构，且生成代码无人工审查，也无预先存在的预言机来验证目标行为。任务是在一个大型相互依赖的代码库中拆除一个核心不变量，作者评估该任务通过增量重构实际上不可行，这类变更通常需要重写。在本文所述的协议下，代理成功完成了该任务。系统是一个包含717,725行生产级TypeScript应用，跨越3,648个文件。任务要求拆除一个核心生命周期不变量：即UI面板在AI请求期间保持打开的保证。目标行为是流式生成在面板关闭后仍能存活，并在重新打开时能重新连接到同一实时流，且无需...
tldr: 本研究展示了一种规范优先协议，使AI编码代理能够在无测试预言机和人工审查的情况下，成功完成对大型代码库中核心架构不变量的拆除，这一任务传统上被认为需要重写。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates a specification-first protocol that enables an AI coding agent to successfully dismantle a core architectural invariant in a large codebase without test oracles or human review, a task traditionally deemed infeasible without a rewrite.
